title: Derived comparison for the explicit affine-resolution complex
statement: For a scheme Y [def-pc-scheme], affine open U, sheaf M, and nonnegative chain complex K, let q be a quasi-isomorphism from the sheafified affine-chart chain complex to the degree-zero single of M restricted to the open subscheme. Assuming the stated derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], the derived restriction of M[0] to the localized site is isomorphic to Q of the explicit cochain complex [def-affine-finite-free-model-complex]. No finiteness, freeness, or boundedness is required.

source.place: Tag 068C, affine finite free resolution argument; Cohomology of Sheaves, Definition 08C4; Derived Categories, Tag 05RU

proof.text: Extend q along embeddingDownNat. Mathlib preserves quasi-isomorphisms under extension and identifies the extended single with the integer single. Apply the inverse open-site equivalence termwise and invert the resulting quasi-isomorphism under Q.

Compose mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor, the degree-zero single of the sheaf isomorphism built from the equivalence unit and overFunctorEquiv, and the inverse singleMapHomologicalComplex comparison. Compose with the inverse of Q applied to the transported quasi-isomorphism.
